name: WhatsApp LLM Bot
postCreateCommand:
apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    libatk1.0-0 \
    libatk-bridge2.0-0 \
    libcups2 \
    libxkbcommon0 \
    libasound2 \
    libxcomposite1 \
    libxdamage1 \
    libxfixes3 \
    libxrandr2 \
    libgbm1 \
    libcairo2 \
    libpango-1.0-0 \
    libnss3 \
    libxss1 \
    libxcursor1 \
    libxi6 \
    libxtst6 \
    fonts-liberation && \
    pip install -r requirements.txt && \
    python -m playwright install chromium
